name: What factors most influence the total cost of a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors most influence the total cost of a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total costs are determined by kitchen dimensions, structural changes, and the quality of chosen finishes. The largest budget categories typically include cabinetry, labor, countertops, and appliances. Minor updates that retain the existing layout cost significantly less than projects requiring wall removal, subfloor leveling, or rough plumbing and electrical relocations. Homeowners should establish an overall budget first and set aside a 10% to 20% contingency reserve to address hidden issues like outdated wiring or concealed water damage discovered behind walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet selection, layout changes, labor, and materials drive the majority of kitchen remodeling costs, alongside any required plumbing or electrical rework.
